blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each term with its coefficient.
blocks.display: Match each term with its coefficient.

blocks.text: Negative six a. The number in front is six, and the minus sign belongs to the term. The coefficient is negative six.
b. No number is written, so the coefficient is one.
Negative c. The hidden coefficient is one, and the minus sign makes it negative one.
Nine y cubed. The exponent is not the coefficient. The coefficient is nine.
Negative d squared. The hidden coefficient is one, and the minus sign makes it negative one.
Every term now has its coefficient. The sign belongs to the coefficient, a hidden coefficient is one, and an exponent is never the coefficient.
